frontier_selector.why: the presence of cyanosis of fingers and toes progressing to well-demarcated gangrene below the elbows and knees, along with ecchymoses and easy bleeding, specifically supports Purpura Fulminans despite the contrast angiogram results.

support_spans: the tips of his fingers and toes appeared cyanosed bilaterally

contradict_spans: a contrast angiogram of the aorta and its branches showed patent thoracic and abdominal aorta and no filling defects in major limb arteries
